subject: Pipeline hygiene: manual concessions flagged on Orion Cloud (action required)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Tully <ben.tully@orioncloud.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline hygiene: manual concessions flagged on Orion Cloud (action required)

Team —

During the weekly pipeline sweep I pulled a short report of deals moved to "Commit" in the last 14 days. I found ORC-2027-0456 (Orion Cloud) shows a 22% manual concession applied to list pricing; that exceeds our standard authorization thresholds and there is no Deal Desk approval logged in the CRM.

Quick facts:
- Account: Orion Cloud
- Rep: Ben Tully (external) / Sales AS-12 profile
- Arr impact: ~$98,500 over 36 months
- CRM stage: Closed - Commit (moved 2027-04-28)
- Evidence attached: flagged-discounts-20270428.csv; dealdeck-OrionCloud.pdf (deck sent by AE)

Requests (please action by EOD Pacific Monday, 2027-05-03):
1) Deal Desk (Marissa) — confirm whether a retro approval exists or if a formal concession request needs to be created. If you need a short justification from the AE, flag which fields are required.
2) Sales (Vanessa/Ben Carter) — if no approval, revert stage to Negotiation or Proposal and mark as uncommitted. Provide brief rationale in the CRM notes.
3) Finance (Karthik) — flag for forecast adjustment if the deal is reverted; note expected ARR swing for Q2.

I attached the export from the sweep (flagged-discounts-20270428.csv) with the row for ORC highlighted. I also included the latest deal deck.

This is a pipeline hygiene issue but it has near-term forecast impact. Please reply-all with the plan and ETA.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Tully <ben.tully@orioncloud.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline hygiene: manual concessions flagged on Orion Cloud (action required)

Thanks Jasmine — good catch. I will model the potential ARR impact for Q2 and publish a delta to the shared forecast workbook today. If Deal Desk confirms there was no approved concession, we should mark this as a "forecast remove" for pipeline math.

Marissa — can you pull the approval history for ORC-2027-0456 and confirm whether this was recorded in the Deal Desk queue? If it was handled outside the system, please escalate with the supporting email trail.

Vanessa/BC — if the AE has a documented justification, attach it to the HubSpot deal and add a one-line note ("Discount justified - see attached justification") so Finance can evaluate. Otherwise we will assume not committed and adjust.

Karthik
Finance Planning & Ops
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Tully <ben.tully@orioncloud.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline hygiene: manual concessions flagged on Orion Cloud (action required)
Attachments: dealdesk-approval-log.xlsx

Jasmine / team —

Pulled the Deal Desk logs and the attached pivot: there is no ticket or approval record for ORC-2027-0456 prior to 2027-04-28. The discount line was added manually on 2027-04-27 by an AE account edit.

Options and recommended next steps:
- Option A (preferred if AE can produce a retroactive justification): AE submits a formal concession request and Deal Desk runs a retro review. If approved, Deal Desk will log the approval and Finance will keep the ARR as committed.
- Option B (if no justification available): Sales re-stages the opportunity to Negotiation; Finance will mark the amount out of committed ARR for the Q2 forecast.

For the retro route we need the following from the AE (min viable): customer justification, commercial contact confirmation (email/Slack), and confirmation that legal has no dependency. If AE can supply those by Monday EOD 2027-05-03 we will prioritize the review.

I have attached the dealdesk-approval-log.xlsx excerpt that shows activity across similar concession bands — use as reference.

Marissa Cole
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
> On Fri, Apr 30, 2027 at 10:03 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Thanks Jasmine — good catch. I will model the potential ARR impact...

From: Ben Tully <ben.tully@orioncloud.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline hygiene: manual concessions flagged on Orion Cloud (action required)

Thanks for the heads up. To be clear: Orion Cloud negotiated the 22% concession during a series of Q4 commercial discussions. Our primary procurement contact (Samantha Li) has been copied on the contract emails and the discount is the reason we accelerated signature. If Redwood moves this back to Negotiation we will need to re-run our internal approval and that will jeopardize the timeline.

Ben
Ben Tully
VP Sales, Orion Cloud
ben.tully@orioncloud.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Tully <ben.tully@orioncloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline hygiene: manual concessions flagged on Orion Cloud (action required)
Attachments: dealdeck-OrionCloud.pdf

Ben — thanks for the color and for looping Samantha. Marissa's findings show no logged Deal Desk approval; if you have the contract thread or DocuSign evidence that shows an approved concession, please share the link (or forward the contract redline). I want to avoid a forecast flip without a documented approval, but also understand the customer timeline risk.

Next steps:
- Ben: please forward the signed DocuSign or the Slack/email thread that documents the concession by EOD Monday 2027-05-03. If we receive documentation, Deal Desk will retro-review and Finance will keep ARR in the committed number.
- Marissa: please prepare a short template for retro requests so reps know what to attach (contract link, CSM confirmation, procurement email).

Appreciate everyone's quick turnaround on this — we want the market-facing forecast to be defensible.

Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
